correctness.rationale: The complete analytic proof gives exact parity splitting for real skew systems, an explicit arcsine Chebyshev-kernel minimizer of limiting residual energy, the fourth moment (2L^2+1)/(3L^3) from Dirichlet convolution, a real-Haar ratio-of-Gaussian-quadratics CLT with centering, and an \(O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})\) variational remainder. The fixed-degree spectral moments converge with \(O(N^{-1}\) deterministic quadrature error. These steps imply the norm variance (2L-1)(L-1)/(6L^2) for every fixed positive integer iteration parameter. Replayed standard-library verifier outputs VERIFY_OK 5540; finite checks do not replace asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: For the natural skew transport stencil and random forcing, the result classifies the complete fixed-step typical error and its sharp \(N^{-1/2}\) variability, with exact coefficients for all q, in contrast with worst-case curves. It gives a nontrivial numerical reliability benchmark involving the interaction of Haar weighting, orthogonal polynomial minimization, and GMRES adaptivity; it does not rely on a gratuitous parameter slice or claim finite-precision performance.
